summary.name: Termius
summary.one_liner: Termius is a modern SSH client for Mac, Windows, Linux, iOS and Android that saves hosts, keys and workspaces and syncs them through an encrypted vault.
use_cases: Connecting to remote Linux servers with saved hosts
Syncing SSH hosts and keys across laptop and phone
Transferring files to servers via SFTP
Sharing server access and session logs with a team
Managing and generating SSH keys in one place
summary.what_it_does: Termius is an SSH client available for macOS, Windows, Linux, iOS and Android. It saves host addresses, ports and credentials so users can connect with one click. It includes an SFTP file browser, port forwarding, and a Keychain for storing passwords, keys and certificates, with a key generator that protects keys with passphrases. Hosts are organized into groups and vaults and can be synced across devices through end-to-end encrypted vaults. For teams, it offers shared vaults, real-time multiplayer terminal sessions, and session logs.
notable: End-to-end encrypted vaults that sync hosts and credentials across devices
Real-time multiplayer terminal sessions and session logs for team audits
Direct connection without relying on cloud, VPN or proxy, per the page
Listed in awesome-mac as a freeware Mac SSH and SFTP client
caveats: Pricing tiers beyond the free trial are not detailed on the page; the page says 'Try Modern SSH client for free'
Team and business features such as SOC 2 report access are described for business customers
Web platform is not clearly named on the page text; platform list is from the page's device icons and the awesome-mac listing
